ck: (30)kasitinanacarya patanistatvankikareneti katapatayo svarupEkyatiti pava yatyapyevan pate katavyavaharapatiriti vaksyananatusananatra sakyate vaktun tatapi pate katatvatyantapavasyEva prakrtopayuktatvataneva tavatankikarayati — pata iti ankikriyanananiti sesa nanu pate katatvasya nityatvepi tatra tatatyantapavankikara kuta ityata aha — sarvesaniti katatinan tatvata svatikaranaprasite svatikaranatvena sanata ityuktan svaprakarakativisesye yavatityarta iti vatata tvayeti sanpanta tataca katatvateretatrsanityatvanurotateva patatO tatatyantapavankikara iti pava nanu svasrayanistapavapratiyokitvaneva nityatvan svasrayatvan ca na vastavan napi pratipasikasataranan yena virota sitartata va syat api tu vyavaharikanevetyasayena sankate — patasyeti suprasitaneveti parasparavirutayoranyataranisetasyanyataravitivyaptatvaniyanatiti pava
s: (३०)काशीतिम्मण्णाचार्य पटनिष्ठत्वाङ्गीकारेणेति घटपटयोः स्वरूपैक्यादिति भावः यद्यप्येवं पटे घटव्यवहारापत्तिरिति वक्ष्यमाणदूषणमत्र शक्यते वक्त
